sentences.text:
THIS MSA IS FILED U/S 54(2) OF THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, 1894 AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 12.01.2015 PASSED IN R.A.NO.418/2014 ON THE FILE OF THE PRINCIPAL DISTRICT JUDGE, HASSAN,
PARTLY ALLOWING THE APPEAL AND MODIFYING THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 02.08.2005 PASSED IN L.A.C.NO.25/2001 ON THE FILE OF THE PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE (SR.DN) HASSAN, PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 18(1) OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT FOR ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL JUDGMENT Case called twice.
None appears for the appellant.
Amendment to the cause title not carried out.
Amended appeal memo is also not filed.
There is a delay of 1349 days in filing the appeal.
Second appeal itself is of the year 2018, whereby the order of the First Appellate Court enhancing the compensation is under challenge.
Taking note of these aspects of the matter, appeal stands dismissed for non prosecution.
